title: Grain pulse
summary: On each hit the grain swells, the colour channels split for a moment and the frame punches in, then it all settles until the next.

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

params.name: last
params.description: the last word; empty takes the brand's name

params.name: format
params.description: output size; the layout recomposes for each

usage:
npx paper-motion add grain-pulse --name my-grain-pulse
# edit CONFIG in pieces/my-grain-pulse/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-grain-pulse/scene.html --motion-blur 5
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work) and, for the field, a shader-set entry.
Recomposes for 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1: set `format` and the layout and camera follow.
